summary: Repaired the completed administrator-account capability gap by adding strict contracts, persistent Mongo projections, verified-admin RBAC routes, transactional create/update behavior, safe projections, duplicate protection, optimistic version checks, self-lockout and last-Super-Admin safeguards, synchronized API artifacts, and regression coverage. The test-suite discovery invariant was also repaired after the new route test exposed that it was not classified in TEST_SUITES.api.

verification.notes: The exact previously failing suite-discovery test file passed 4/4 after classifying administrator-router.test.ts in the API suite.
Three consecutive explicit invocations of the isolated failing test file passed; the focused administrator route/service/model set passed 13/13 in the same verification command.
Complete serialized API unit suite passed 372/372, including the repaired harness invariant.
API route suite passed 104/104, including administrator authentication, permission, strict-input, safe-projection, and stale-update coverage.
API source and test typecheck passed.
Root contracts, API, and Web typecheck passed.
Root lint passed. The API workspace has no separate lint script.
Root production build passed; only the repository's existing large-chunk warning was emitted.
No high-severity dependency vulnerabilities were reported.
Inventory reports implemented GET list, GET detail, POST create, and PATCH update administrator routes under /api/v1/admin/admin-users.
Agent Pack audit reported zero errors before closure.

scopeNotes: The runtime wiring and artifact files outside apps/api/src/modules/admin/** were necessary integration points for the selected administrator API capability and are listed explicitly rather than treated as unrelated scope.

apps/api/src/modules/testing/test-suites.ts was updated only to classify the new administrator route regression test; the harness failure was a real repository-owned discovery invariant, not a weakened assertion.
No production credentials, secrets, fake administrator records, or production mocks were introduced.
The persistent repository uses the existing transaction boundary and records optional audit evidence without exposing credentials or storage internals.
knownGaps: A live transaction test was not run because an isolated non-production MongoDB replica-set topology was not available; deterministic repository and route tests cover the transaction boundary and the implementation fails closed when the required topology is unavailable.

Administrator credential creation and authentication remain owned by the existing identity/authentication boundary; this task exposes only the safe administrator account management projection and mutations defined by its contracts.
The repository has no separate apps/api lint script; root lint was the applicable lint gate.
The repository has no security:check script; dependency audit and API authorization/security matrices were run, and the unavailable command was not reported as passed.
